facts.premium: Highest pay tier in the South — Phuket's tourism wages and living costs are well above the regional norm.
facts.skill_gap: Hospitality-skewed labour market; high demand for service skills, limited industrial/technical employment.
workers: Tour operators, drivers and tuk-tuk/taxi owners
~67% informal workforce (473k of 705k) despite high incomes
impacts: Phuket's entire economy rides on foreign arrivals; any travel shock hits incomes island-wide at once.
63% motorcycles plus very high vehicle ownership — large, liquid moto-title collateral pool.
Elevated living costs push even well-paid workers toward short-term cash credit.
Highest EV count outside major metros signals a richer, more bankable urban segment.
Low-season cash crunch and single-sector concentration raise correlated PD across the island.
Construction and property swings amplify both income gains and downturns.
